title: Basic Single Inheritance
description: Create a base class and a derived class, then use them in main.
constraints: Define a class named Animal and a derived class named Dog. Use them in main.
sampleOutput:
Species: Canine, Breed: Golden Retriever
Animal is eating.
Dog is barking!
explanation: The output shows the result of calling the required methods and accessing data members.

title: Method Overriding in Derived Class
description: Show how a derived class can override a method of its base class.
constraints: Define a base class Shape and derived classes Circle and Rectangle. Each must have a draw() method.
sampleOutput:
Drawing a generic shape.
Drawing a circle.
Drawing a rectangle.
explanation: For each object, draw() produces its own output.

title: Protected Members in Inheritance
description: Demonstrate access to protected members of a base class from a derived class.
constraints: Define a class Vehicle with a protected member. Define Car derived from Vehicle. Use them in main.
explanation: The output shows the value of the protected member accessed via the derived class.

title: Calling Base Class Constructor from Derived
description: Show how to call a base class constructor from a derived class.
constraints: Define classes Person and Student. Student constructor must use a member initializer list to call Person's constructor.
explanation: The output displays the student's name and ID.

title: Virtual Functions and Runtime Polymorphism
description: Implement base and derived classes using virtual functions to demonstrate runtime polymorphism.
constraints: Define a base class Animal with virtual void make_sound(). Define Dog and Cat derived classes that override make_sound().
explanation: The output is produced by calling make_sound() on each derived type through a base pointer.

title: Abstract Base Class and Pure Virtual Functions
description: Implement an abstract base class and concrete derived classes with pure virtual functions.
constraints: Define an abstract class PaymentMethod with a pure virtual function process_payment(). Define CreditCardPayment and PayPalPayment derived classes.
sampleOutput:
Processing Credit Card payment of $150.75.
Processing PayPal payment of $75.00.
explanation: The output is produced by the process_payment() implementations for each payment type.

title: Virtual Destructors for Proper Cleanup
description: Show why a virtual destructor is needed in a base class for proper cleanup.
constraints: Define a base class Base with a virtual destructor. Define a derived class Derived with its own destructor.
sampleOutput:
Derived object created.
Derived destructor called.
Base destructor called.
explanation: The output shows the construction and destruction order for base and derived objects.

title: Multiple Inheritance (Diamond Problem Intro)
description: Implement a class using multiple inheritance to demonstrate the diamond problem.
constraints: Define classes Walker and Swimmer. Define Amphibian inheriting from both. Each should have its own action method.
sampleOutput:
Amphibian abilities:
Walker is walking.
Swimmer is swimming.
explanation: The output shows methods from both base classes being called from the derived class.

title: Virtual Base Classes (Diamond Problem Resolution)
description: Resolve the diamond problem using virtual base classes.
constraints: Define Device, Scanner, Printer, and MultifunctionDevice. Scanner and Printer must inherit virtually from Device.
sampleOutput:
Device detected.
Scanning document...
Printing page...
explanation: The output shows all methods called correctly with diamond inheritance resolved.

title: Employee Payroll System (Polymorphic Processing)
description: Create a payroll system using inheritance and polymorphism for different employee types.
constraints: Define an abstract Employee class with virtual destructor and pure virtual functions. Implement SalariedEmployee, HourlyEmployee, and CommissionEmployee derived classes.
sampleOutput:
--- Payroll Summary ---
Name: Alice (Salaried), Weekly Salary: $1000.00
Payroll: $1000.00

Name: Bob (Hourly), Hourly Rate: $20.00, Hours Worked: 40
Payroll: $800.00

Name: Carol (Commission), Commission: $150.00, Sales: $2000.00
Payroll: $550.00
explanation: The output shows payroll details for each type of employee.
